analysis:
## Technical analysis

### August 27, 2026 — Post-Earnings Day One: Buy the News Confirmed

The regular session proved the bull case decisively. NVDA gapped open from $209.66 (Aug 26 regular-session close) to approximately $222-$223 (consistent with the AH close ~$223 from the Q2 FY2027 earnings beat), then traded higher to close at **$227.98 (+8.74%)** on **293.3 million shares** — the highest post-earnings day volume of 2026.

### Session Structure

| Metric | Value | Context |
|--------|-------|----------|
| Gap open | ~$222-$223 | From AH $213.04 → $223 (Aug 26 AH) |
| Day low | $220.90 | Held triple-bottom zone lower bound ($219.74) |
| Close | $227.98 | Near session high |
| Volume | 293.3M shares | 106% above 3-month avg (142.1M) |
| Change | +$18.32 / +8.74% | vs Aug 26 close $209.66 |
| Gate buffer | $27.98 / 12.3% | $227.98 vs $200 step-aside |

### The Critical Technical Test — Day Low at Triple-Bottom Zone

The most important technical development on Aug 27 was where the session low held: $220.90. Compare this to the triple-bottom zone's lower boundary: $219.74. The gap between the session low and the lower bound is **$1.16** — a margin so thin it confirms the zone acted as support to the penny.

The mechanics: the triple-bottom range ($219.74-$224.86) accumulated enormous overhead supply across three sessions (Aug 19-21). That same supply becomes support post-breakout — the accounts who sold NVDA at $219-$225 were short and have since covered (stopped out in AH and pre-market); the accounts who bought in that range are profitable and not sellers; new buyers at $220-$228 are initiating with the FY2028 70% growth guide as anchor. The result: when NVDA dipped to $220.90 intraday, institutional buyers absorbed the selling immediately.

### Trend — All Three Moving Averages Far Below Close

| Average | Level (est.) | Close $227.98 | Status |
|---------|-------------|-----------|--------|
| 20-DMA | ~$215.50 | Above by ~$12.48 | WELL CLEAR |
| 50-DMA | ~$210.00 | Above by ~$17.98 | WELL CLEAR |
| 200-DMA | ~$197.00 | Above by ~$30.98 | WELL CLEAR |

The 20-DMA (rising ~$0.50/day) was never threatened in today's session. The day low of $220.90 was $5.40 above the 20-DMA. This is the strongest moving-average spacing NVDA has shown in Gate 3.

### ★ Strongest Support — $219.74-$220.90 (Triple-Bottom Zone / Session Low Confluence)

The triple-bottom zone was resistance for three sessions (Aug 19-21), then overhead supply for two AH sessions (Aug 26-27), and is now confirmed support on the first regular-session test. Role-reversal support is typically the most durable form — the zone has been 'priced in' by accounts on both sides.

**Evidence for the $219.74-$220.90 support:**
1. Three prior sessions tested $219.74-$224.86 from above (resistance confirmed × 3)
2. Today's session low $220.90 held within $1.16 of the zone's lower bound ($219.74)
3. Volume at the session low was not elevated — dip-buyers absorbed without panic
4. The same accounts who accumulated in the Gate 3 / BUY LOW window ($208-$213) are profitable and anchoring the zone from below

### ★ Strongest Resistance — $232-$234 (Straddle Upper Break-Even)

The pre-earnings straddle ($18-$20/share, upper break-even ~$232-$234) creates a mechanical resistance wall that:  
1. **Scale**: A $20 straddle at ~293M shares × (fraction held in options) = hundreds of millions of notional gamma exposure  
2. **Systematic exit**: Options sellers who sold straddles pre-earnings sell spot (or calls) as NVDA approaches $232-$234 to lock in gains below the upper break-even  
3. **Timeline**: This resistance is options-expiry-driven; as Sep expiry approaches (3rd Friday Sep), the $232-$234 resistance softens as those options expire worthless (from the options sellers' perspective)  
4. **Next wall**: Above $234, the 52-week high ($236.54) is the only remaining technical resistance

### Volume — Institutional Conviction at Scale

293.3 million shares at an average price ~$224 (between open and close) = **~$65.8B notional** traded in a single session. This is institutional-scale demand:
- 106% above the 3-month average (142.1M shares)
- Highest post-earnings day volume of 2026
- Volume CONFIRMS the price move — no divergence between volume and direction

The typical post-earnings mean-reversion pattern (historical avg -2.79% day-after) requires at least equal volume selling pressure. 293M shares of buyers on Aug 27 sets a very high bar for a reversal on Aug 28.

### Momentum and RSI

Pre-earnings RSI was ~49 (neutral). An +8.74% single-session move adds approximately 15-20 RSI points depending on the lookback period. Estimated post-Aug 27 RSI: 65-70 (bullish momentum zone, not yet overbought at 70). The MACD histogram (was negative ~-1.26 pre-earnings) will flip strongly positive with the gap open. Momentum indicators all confirm the bullish reversal: short-term momentum was oversold pre-earnings (7-session losing streak Aug 14-24) and is now recovering to neutral-to-bullish.

### Pattern: Earnings Gap-and-Hold (Most Constructive Variant)

The pattern visible on Aug 27 is the 'earnings gap-and-hold' — the most constructive post-earnings pattern:
- Gap: NVDA opens $12-$13 above prior regular close ($209.66 → $222-$223)
- Hold: The gap is never filled intraday (day low $220.90 is above the Aug 26 close $209.66)
- Confirm: Close near session highs ($227.98) with the day low ABOVE the triple-bottom zone lower bound

A filled-gap would have meant NVDA traded back to $209.66 — that did not happen. The gap held.

### Analyst Upgrade Wave — August 27 Price Targets

| Analyst | Firm | Prior PT | New PT | Rating | Upside from $227.98 |
|---------|------|---------|--------|--------|--------------------|
| Simon Leopold | Raymond James | $352 | $550 | Buy | +141% |
| Kevin Cassidy | Rosenblatt | $325 | $390 | Buy | +71% |
| Matt Bryson | Wedbush | $330 | $345 | Outperform | +51% |

All three analysts raised on Aug 27, citing the 70% FY2028 growth guidance as the key variable that changes their valuation models. The Raymond James $550 target — if achieved — represents a ~$13.4T market cap, which would make NVIDIA larger than the combined market cap of all US banks + all US energy companies.

### What Would Change the Read

**Maintain BUY HIGH**: NVDA closes above $220.90 (triple-bottom zone support) on any volume over the next 5 sessions — the gap-and-hold pattern is intact and Q3 FY2027 earnings (Nov 2026) are the next binary.

**Downgrade to BUY MEDIUM**: A close below $220.90 (triple-bottom zone lower bound) on 150M+ shares — 'gap-and-fail' pattern would signal that the zone was not genuine support; conviction drops to MEDIUM but gate ($200) still active.

**Downgrade to BUY LOW**: A close below $215 (20-DMA zone) — would signal a full gap fill attempt; extremely unlikely given the FY2028 70% growth guidance and 293M shares of buying on Aug 27.

**Step Aside**: Regular-session close below $200 — Gate 1 trigger; $27.98/12.3% away from today's close.
